claim: Let \(G_1,\ldots,G_5\) be the five pairwise nonisomorphic asymmetric cubic Hamiltonian graphs on twelve vertices, represented respectively by graph6 strings K?ABE`Ke@WEO, K?ABCfCU@WF?, K?ABAdgi?wQ_, K?AB?tos@WP_, and K?`@EaKX?sEO, and equip each graph with its unweighted shortest-path metric. For the inclusive Vietoris--Rips filtration, all five complexes are twelve discrete points for \(0\le r<1\). For \(1\le r<2\), their homotopy types are respectively \(\bigvee^6S^1,\bigvee^6S^1,\bigvee^5S^1,\bigvee^6S^1,\bigvee^4S^1\). For \(2\le r<3\), the homotopy type is \(\bigvee^2S^2\) for \(G_1\) and \(S^2\) for each of \(G_2,\ldots,G_5\). For every graph the complex is contractible for \(r\ge3\).
integrity: All finite claims are reconstructed from graph6 encodings by a standalone standard-library verifier. Exact graph properties, distances, simplices, Hasse covers, matchings, critical cells, and acyclicity are checked directly; no finite experiment is used as evidence for a statement beyond the five finite graphs.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to unweighted shortest-path metrics on the five twelve-vertex asymmetric cubic Hamiltonian isomorphism classes. Exhaustion uses the published exact class count; the verifier checks the five representatives but does not independently enumerate all eighty cubic Hamiltonian graphs on twelve vertices. An unindexed prior computation may exist.
title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris–Rips filtrations of the five asymmetric cubic Hamiltonian graphs on twelve vertices
